item.title: Scientists ejected from diabetes conference for distributing journal reprints
item.description:
📝 The five were handing out reprints of the editorial outside a room where NIH director Jay Bhattacharya had been scheduled to speak. “They were respectfully given the opportunity to cease this behavior and chose not to which is why they were escorted out. ” DOI: Diabetes Care, 2026.
🔗 Read more: https://arstechnica.com/science/2026/06/scientists-ejected-from-diabetes-conference-for-distributing-journal-reprints/
